purpose: Run a suspect-blind Janus-style reverse-pattern test over repository JSON records as a strict JSON -> independent check -> frozen status -> next JSON pipeline, followed only afterwards by a separate recurrence/gate aggregation pass.

queue_contract.reason: The queue is deterministic but independent of names, people, topics, suspected identities, and expected outcomes.

phase_1_independent_record_check.rule: No record may be promoted by another record during phase 1. A record can only receive a structural status supported by its own source body.

phase_2_frozen_receipt_aggregation.mirror_gate: Requires an independent-record MIRROR_OR_SYMMETRY witness together with paired reverse/forward or bidirectional directional evidence.
phase_2_frozen_receipt_aggregation.backforth_gate: Requires explicit BACK/FORWARD recurrence in a direction array, BACK_AGAIN/FORWARD_AGAIN, or an exact forward/inverse-return replay pairing.
phase_2_frozen_receipt_aggregation.promotion_rule: PATTERN_PROMOTION_CANDIDATE requires repeat_gate AND (mirror_gate OR backforth_gate). Structural promotion never confirms semantic identity, causality, prophecy, agency, or external-world linkage.

negative_preservation.INVALID_JSON: Retain as a corpus receipt; do not infer structured operators from malformed content.
negative_preservation.NOT_APPLICABLE: Retain in denominator and corpus ledger where applicable.
negative_preservation.OBSERVATION: Do not rewrite as candidate because a later record looks similar.
negative_preservation.REJECT_FAIL_BLOCKED_OPEN: These source states remain explicit evidence states and are not overwritten by later PASS records.
negative_preservation.duplicate_or_lineage_related_support: Must not be counted as independent recurrence merely because wording or schema repeats.

next_gate: Run the frozen executor on the exact branch snapshot. Review only promotion candidates after the full receipt ledger is complete; any semantic interpretation must be a separate source-grounded test with its own preregistration.
